about: Recurring cast of the ted-MG motion graphics Shorts (format "tedmg"). Drawn by shorts/design_kit/tedmg-kit.jsx (MGBust / MGPerson / MGHead with who=<id>) — never redraw a cast member by hand. Background people: MG.extra(i). Append each episode to the character's history.
style: Flat-vector cartoon: big round cream heads, dot eyes with expressive brows, thick ink outlines, warm muted scenes. White + amber condensed captions. Reference: shorts/styles/tedmg/.

milo.name: Milo
milo.look: tall dark quiff, white button shirt
milo.personality: self-conscious and kind; sure everyone is watching and judging him; funny when he relaxes
history: ep 1 (milo-coffee-stain): spotlight effect — coffee stain at the party, nobody noticed; tomorrow he gives a speech

ep 2 (shaky-bridge): first date in two days; Theo says make it scary (Dutton & Aron 1974 shaky bridge, misattribution of arousal); Milo books a horror escape room, then remembers he is scared of the dark — PART 2
ep 3 (talk-to-yourself, with Nia): the speech from ep 1 — catches Nia talking to herself by name, learns self-distancing (Kross et al. 2014), coaches himself by name and goes on calm
ep 4 (lima-syndrome): locked in Rosa's escape room with June; tells her about his speech

ep 5 (milo-snap-judgment, with Dev): Dev is 20 min late, Milo decides he's "just unreliable"; next week Milo is late and blames the bus; fundamental attribution error (Jones & Harris 1967: readers still judged an assigned pro-Castro writer as pro-Castro, 44.1 vs 22.9)

ep 6 (milo-lottery-ticket, with Theo): buys a lottery ticket and spends the millions in his head; hedonic adaptation (Brickman, Coates & Janoff-Bulman 1978: 22 winners no happier, enjoyed everyday pleasures less); no win, Theo hands him toast

ep 7 (milo-google-egg, with Nia): googles 'boiled egg time' for the third time this week; Google effect (Sparrow, Liu & Wegner 2011: people told the computer would save facts remembered them less, but remembered where they were saved)

nia.name: Nia
nia.look: black curly hair, mustard top, deep skin tone
nia.personality: confident, practical, blunt; the one who says 'nobody saw it, Milo'
history: ep 1 (first-impressions, with Rosa): "they'll judge your face first"

ep 2 (talk-to-yourself, with Milo): pep-talks herself by name in the mirror; Milo, 5 min before his speech, thinks she's lost it, while his own head spirals in 'I' (Kross et al. 2014 self-distancing); he tries 'Milo, you've done harder things' and walks on stage calm
ep 3 (ikea-effect, with Theo): six hours on a wobbly shelf, prices it at $100 vs $40 new (IKEA effect, Norton, Mochon & Ariely 2012: builders paid 63% more); Theo then hands her his flat-pack desk
ep 4 (rosa-start-monday, with Rosa): smirks at "I'll start Monday", then texts "gym? 7am. no excuses" for the new month
ep 5 (rosa-five-signs, with Rosa): hands Rosa her review back and makes her read the nice ones out loud (negativity bias)
ep 6 (june-dont-think, with June): teaches June the one-other-thing trick (focused distraction, the red Volkswagen from Wegner 1987)
ep 7 (milo-google-egg, with Milo): laughs at Milo's re-Googling; 'your brain filed it under PHONE'

theo.name: Theo
theo.look: short grey hair, round glasses, green cardigan
theo.personality: dry humour, retired teacher; explains the psychology with a story
history: ep 1 (shaky-bridge, with Milo): tells Milo about the shaky-bridge study

ep 2 (decision-facts, with Dev): bets Dev three facts about choosing — defaults (Johnson & Goldstein 2003 organ donors 42% vs 82%), the jam study (Iyengar & Lepper 2000, mixed replications), the decoy (Huber, Payne & Puto 1982); calls it choice architecture
ep 3 (ikea-effect): offers Nia $20 for her shelf, names the IKEA effect
ep 4 (june-doorway): laughs 'blame the door'
ep 5 (dev-overthink-putt): hums a tune at mini golf so Dev stops overthinking his putt; high five
ep 6 (milo-lottery-ticket, with Milo): checks the numbers, no win; hands Milo a slice of toast — the small stuff isn't small
ep 7 (dev-silver-medal, with Dev): beams on the bronze step — 'at least I medaled' — and makes room for Dev

rosa.name: Rosa
rosa.personality: ambitious people-pleaser; says yes to everything, then panics
history: ep 1 (first-impressions): rehearsed 40 interview answers; learns faces are judged in 0.1 s and the halo effect, bins the script and smiles at the receptionist first

ep 2 (lima-syndrome, with Milo + June): new escape-room game master; no-hints rule collapses, whispers answers, opens the door at minute 30 (Lima syndrome, 1996 Lima hostage crisis; one case, not lab studies)

ep 3 (rosa-start-monday, with Nia): Thursday night, crisps in hand, swears "I'll start Monday"; fresh start effect (Dai, Milkman & Riis 2014: diet searches, gym visits and commitment contracts rise after temporal landmarks); goes to the gym on the 1st with Nia

ep 4 (rosa-five-signs, with Nia): performance review with nine compliments and one 'could improve' — rereads the bad one five times; 5-signs list on negativity bias (Baumeister, Bratslavsky, Finkenauer & Vohs 2001); Nia makes her read the nice ones out loud

ep 5 (rosa-deleted-compliment, with Dev): types 'your talk was amazing!' to Dev, deletes it as too awkward; Zhao & Epley 2021 (senders underestimate how good compliments feel); sends it, Dev screenshots it

dev.name: Dev
dev.look: buzz cut, full beard, blue top, brown skin
dev.personality: laid-back gym coach and confident talker; overestimates himself (Dunning–Kruger material)
history: ep 1 (doodlers, with June): sat perfectly still in the meeting and went blank; now doodles sharks
ep 2 (decision-facts, with Theo): insists nobody tells him what to choose, loses the bet, then buys the large popcorn because the medium cost almost the same

ep 3 (dev-armchair, with June): paid $50 for an armchair, wants $200 ('it has memories'); endowment effect (Kahneman, Knetsch & Thaler 1990 mugs: ~$7 vs ~$3); June asks 'would you buy it today for $200?' and he takes $40
ep 4 (milo-snap-judgment, with Milo): 20 min late, written off as unreliable; really his bus broke down and he walked

ep 5 (dev-overthink-putt, with Theo): last hole of mini golf, overthinks a 2-foot putt and misses; choking / explicit monitoring (Beilock, Carr, MacMahon & Starkes 2002: experienced golfers putted better distracted than focusing on each step; novices the opposite); sinks it once Theo hums

ep 6 (dev-silver-medal, with Theo): wins silver at the fun run 5K and sulks while Theo grins in third; counterfactual thinking (Medvec, Madey & Gilovich 1995: raters judged 1992 Olympic bronze medalists happier than silver); 'test' pattern; steps down to stand with Theo
ep 7 (rosa-deleted-compliment, with Rosa): gets Rosa's compliment and screenshots it

june.name: June
june.look: ginger bun, round glasses, teal top
june.personality: anxious student and planner; procrastinates, then overprepares
history: ep 1 (doodlers): doodling — June spirals through the meeting, Dev says she is not listening, but she is the one who remembers (Andrade 2009); next meeting Dev doodles sharks
ep 2 (lima-syndrome): shares her snacks with game-master Rosa; walks out early
ep 3 (dev-armchair): offers Dev $40 for his armchair and walks off with it
ep 4 (june-doorway, with Theo): walks into the kitchen and forgets why, remembers at her desk (scissors); doorway effect (Radvansky et al. 2011); ends holding the scissors with no idea what for

ep 5 (june-dont-think, with Nia): 1 AM, trying not to think about her ex — every song, every street is him; white bear / rebound effect (Wegner, Schneider, Carter & White 1987); Nia's trick: think about one other thing on purpose (a red car)
